summary.en: Audio editor with an official Arm64 MSI installer and portable archive on the download page.
summary.zh-TW: 音訊編輯軟體，官方下載頁提供 Arm64 的 MSI 安裝程式與免安裝版。

caveats.en: The download page says the Arm64 builds have no plugin support.
caveats.zh-TW: 官方下載頁註明 Arm64 版本不支援外掛。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。
